sql: with p as (  select market_ticker t, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser,   split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||'-'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) ev,   strategy, side, assumed_price px, quantity q, pnl, resolved_value rv, created_at, closed_at, status  from paper_trades  where split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH','KXWTACHALLENGERMATCH')    and status in ('settled','closed_sl') and strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not like '%\_pt%' and pnl is not null and quantity>0), e as (select ev, max(closed_at) ev_end from p group by ev), mk as (  select p.ser, p.ev, p.t, p.side, avg(px) px, 100*sum(pnl)/sum(q) cpc,   bool_or(pnl<0) lost, min(created_at) c0,   extract(epoch from (max(e.ev_end)-min(p.created_at)))/3600 hrs  from p join e on e.ev=p.ev group by 1,2,3,4), x as (  select ser, ev, t, cpc, lost, 100-px tail,   case when 100-px<=5 then 'a<=5' when 100-px<=7 then 'b6-7' when 100-px<=10 then 'c8-10' when 100-px<=20 then 'd11-20' else 'e>20' end band,   case when hrs<0.5 then 'a<0.5h' when hrs<1 then 'b0.5-1h' when hrs<2 then 'c1-2h' when hrs<4 then 'd2-4h' when hrs<24 then 'e4-24h' else 'f>24h' end tb,   to_char(c0,'YYYY-MM') mon from mk), cells as (  select 'band' dim, ser, band cell, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail from x  union all select 'time', ser, tb, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail from x  union all select 'month', ser, mon, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail from x  union all select 'all', ser, 'all', ev, t, cpc, lost, tail from x), g as (select dim, ser, cell, ev, sum(cpc)/100.0 gp from cells group by 1,2,3,4) select c.dim, c.ser, c.cell, count(*) mkts, round(avg(c.tail),2) be_pct,  round(100*avg(case when c.lost then 1 else 0 end),2) loss_pct, round(avg(c.cpc),2) c_per_mkt,  (select count(*) from g where g.dim=c.dim and g.ser=c.ser and g.cell=c.cell) games,  (select round(avg(gp)::numeric,4) from g where g.dim=c.dim and g.ser=c.ser and g.cell=c.cell) mean_g,  (select round((stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)))::numeric,4) from g where g.dim=c.dim and g.ser=c.ser and g.cell=c.cell) se_g,  (select count(*) filter (where gp<0) from g where g.dim=c.dim and g.ser=c.ser and g.cell=c.cell) games_lost from cells c group by 1,2,3 order by 2,1,3
